extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and patent attorneys filing South African patent applications
extracted.subtask_description: Completing Form P.3 (Declaration and Power of Attorney) under the South African Patents Act (1978) to declare applicant/inventor status, claim priority, and appoint patent attorneys as address for service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant identity declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: I/we am/are the applicant(s) mentioned above;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The declarant must confirm they are the applicant(s) named on the form. Ensure the full name(s) of applicant(s) are entered in the designated field(s) (FIELD 22 / 71 in form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarant authorization and capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: I/we have been authorized by the applicant(s) to make this declaration and have knowledge of the facts herein stated in the capacity of ____ of the applicant(s);
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the declarant's capacity (e.g., director, partner, agent). This affirms the person signing is authorized and knowledgeable. If the applicant is a natural person, paragraph 2 should be deleted (see completion notes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventorship and acquisition of right to apply (assignment)
rubrics_metrics.description: the inventor(s) of the abovementioned invention is/are the person(s) named above and the applicant(s) has/have acquired the right to apply by virtue of an assignment from the inventor(s);
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the right to apply was not acquired by assignment, delete the phrase 'an assignment from the inventor(s)' and provide details of how the right was acquired. Ensure inventor full name(s) are entered (FIELD 72 / 71).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement on absence of lawful ground for revocation
rubrics_metrics.description: to the best of my/our knowledge and belief, if a patent is granted on the application, there will be no lawful ground for the revocation of the patent;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declarant must attest that, to their knowledge/belief, no lawful grounds exist that would invalidate a granted patent. This is a sworn factual/legal assurance about the application's validity risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convention application / earliest priority statement
rubrics_metrics.description: this is a convention application and the earliest application from which priority is claimed as set out above is the first application in a convention country in respect of the invention claimed in any of the claims;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If claiming priority, supply earliest priority country, number and date in the designated fields (COUNTRY / NUMBER / DATE). Note: 'The country must be indicated by its International Abbreviation - see schedule 4 of the Regulations.' For non‑convention applications, delete paragraph 5 (see completion notes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment and powers of patent attorneys (power of attorney/address for service)
rubrics_metrics.description: the partners and qualified staff of the firm of __, patent attorneys, are authorised, jointly and severally, with powers of substitution and revocation, to represent the applicant(s) in this application and to be the address for service of the applicant(s) while the application is pending and after a patent has been granted on the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter the full name of the patent attorney firm. This grants the firm authority to act, substitute, revoke, and receive service on behalf of the applicant during pendency and post-grant. Provide the firm's address for service on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form identification and statutory authority
rubrics_metrics.description: REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA PATENTS ACT, 1978 DECLARATION AND POWER OF ATTORNEY (Section 30 - Regulation 8, 22(i)(c) and 33) FORM P.3
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form is made under the cited Act and Regulations; completion must comply with those statutory provisions. Use the form P.3 for the Declaration and Power of Attorney stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory form fields to be completed
rubrics_metrics.description: PATENT APPLICATION NO; REF; LODGING DATE; FULL NAME(S) OF APPLICANT(S); FULL NAME(S) OF INVENTOR(S); EARLIEST PRIORITY CLAIMED (COUNTRY / NUMBER / DATE); TITLE OF INVENTION
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All header and field entries must be completed as applicable. Ensure dates, names, application numbers and the invention title are correctly entered in the corresponding fields (form field numbers like 21, 22, 71, 72, 31, 32, 54 indicated on the form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority country abbreviation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: NOTE: The country must be indicated by its International Abbreviation - see schedule 4 of the Regulations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When entering the priority country, use the official international abbreviation per Schedule 4 of the Regulations (e.g., 'US', 'GB'). Refer to the Regulations for the correct codes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature, date and place of signing
rubrics_metrics.description: SIGNED AT ____ THIS ____ DAY OF ____ 20__ SIGNATURE(S) (no legalization necessary)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide place, day, month and year of signing and signatures of the required signatory/signatories. The form notes that no legalization of signatures is necessary. If the applicant is a company/partnership/firm, give full names of signatories and enter their capacity (see conditional deletion guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditional completion instructions (delete/modify paragraphs as applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: In the case of application in the name of a company, partnership or firm, give full names of signatory/signatories, delete paragraph 1, and enter capacity of each signatory  If the applicant is a natural person, delete paragraph 2. If the right to apply is not by virtue of an assignment from the inventor(s), delete  'an assignmnt from the inventw(s)' and give details of acquisition of right. For non-convenuon applications, delete paragraph 5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the instructed deletions/modifications based on the applicant type and acquisition of rights: - Company/partnership/firm: delete paragraph 1, list signatories' full names and state capacity. - Natural person applicant: delete paragraph 2. - If right not by assignment: remove assignment wording and supply acquisition details. - Non‑convention application: delete paragraph 5. Note typographical errors in the printed form ('assignmnt', 'inventw(s)', 'convenuon') should be corrected substantively when completing.
